content: Photo upload guidance converges on: primary photo = clear face, no sunglasses/heavy filters/odd crops/busy background; square images ~1080x1080px recommended; face must be clearly visible in every uploaded photo per platform guidelines. Liveness/selfie-video verification (compare video to uploaded photos via facial-geometry matching) is the modern standard for automated face-match verification, used by Tinder/Bumble at scale -- out of scope for a manual-review pilot but validates that manual photo review is a reasonable lower-cost substitute.
